queries.sql:
SELECT
          id,
          name,
          type,
          status,
          currency,
          balance_amount,
          debt_balance_amount,
          credit_limit_amount,
          institution_name,
          description,
          created_at,
          updated_at
        FROM accounts
        ORDER BY name ASC;

SELECT amount, type, direction FROM transactions
         WHERE date >= ? AND date < ? AND status = ?
           AND substr(date, 1, ?) = ? AND ((type = ? AND direction = ?) OR (type = ? AND direction = ?))
         ORDER BY date DESC, created_at DESC;
